title: The game i would build tonight, if i had tokens..
author: WingNutOnYaNan
selftext:
​

I should be a guy running a beach bar on a remote beach.

Extremely rarely will i get a customer that i can have great and withy banter with.

Enormous variations in clientel. But very scarce. Almost deserted island.

Palm trees. Bar is on the beach.

Graphics must be epic and serene. Changing weather. Must be a tranquil and cosy game.

Lots of sidequests related to island life. Sunburn. Shopkeeping. Sneaky funny crabs doing shenanigans. Birds. Coconuts. Boats.  Absolutely tiny bar. Basicaly just a piece of driftwood in the beginning. But will expand if game is played well, must be a mechanism for this. Waves, wavesounds. Whales. 

Extremely rarely a hot girl(guy?) comes by. It should be possible but nearly impossible to get her number thru banter, service, kindness and charm

If you make it i will play it online. (If its free)

Extra cudos if it can be installed and run on a Samsung/Tizen tv. 

Competition... Who creates the best beach bar game before monday?
